extraction.Name: William Bridgeman
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to T.C. Montgomery for $1500 on August 10, 1923; conveyed by deed to Winnie M. Keller for $1.00 and other valuable consideration on November 21, 1923
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739681 issued; north half of section 15, township 102, range 77; receipt for patent signed by allottee April 3, 1920; conveyance subject to encumbrances of record; wife also signed the deed to Winnie M. Keller
